title: Correctness of the round programs
statement: For every Boolean word $x$ and every streaming seam state $s$, form the round request by pairing the encoded seam word of $s$ with $x$. The next-state program on that request returns the encoded seam state produced by one streaming round on $x$ from $s$, and the chunk program returns exactly the output of that round.
replaced:
On every canonical round request — the pair encoding of the encoded seam word of
any state $s$ (not only reachable ones) with the input $x$ — the word-level
next-state program returns the encoded word of the state after one streaming
round, and the word-level chunk program returns exactly the chunk emitted by that
round.
